text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Good work today. That concludes all of today's training.
choice_data_list: That was pretty tough, but are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes... but it did take a bit of a toll on me,
so to prepare for tomorrow, I shall rest well—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Bouquet-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Um, Kiseki-san... is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, so um—
Could you be the chaser for me right now!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. If you're fine with me—
choice_data_list: Wait! I can't follow what you're saying at all!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'm sorry, with this,
it's impossible to even read between the lines.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, right now, I'm conceptualizing an action manga
with a "pursuer" theme.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A breathless battle of wits against a tough, relentless pursuer,
and the shocking truth hidden beneath it all!
That's the kind of story I'm aiming to draw—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My, it's just like a movie—
It looks terribly exciting.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! ...Though I've hit a wall
with the crucial design for the pursuer...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right then, seeing Bouquet-chan training,
I thought, 'This is it!'

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Me—? Not to state the obvious,
but... I don't think I'm very well-suited
for rough business...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That's the best part!
A lovely, delicate girl silently
and relentlessly chasing after you to the ends of the earth."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It should be able to convey a different kind of dread
from a super-buff battle cyborg!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I want to actually be chased
to get a real sense of realism!
So please! Chase after me!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...What do you think, Trainer?
I believe it would be good for building stamina, but...
choice_data_list: Looks like it'll be good training, maybe!
Could we do this another day...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Kiseki—
how shall we proceed?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"She stayed a set distance behind me,
but every now and then she'd close in
right onto my tail."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Keep your face completely blank and hit 'em with a quiet, intimidating aura—that'd be the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Understood...
I'll chase after you with everything I have to live up to your expectations—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry I couldn't live up to your expectations...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, please don't worry about it!
I think I was asking on too short notice, anyway.
I'll ask you again some other time.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes. When that time comes, I promise I will pursue you—with everything I've got.
